title: TnT Railgun Using Minecraft's Quantum Mechanics
description:
Here's a cool idea, how about we build an armour piercing TnT railgun using what I consider to be Minecraft's quantum mechanics. In this video we explore how we can use advanced subtick mechanics to manipulate redstone to do things your average redstoner could only dream of.

Check out Space Walker's paper about subtick mechanics to learn more:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nn6-zg2YBIIf0BTSijpmLztV5oasVI_4H-k5bwU6KdE/edit
